evidence.oralText: 13 days into November and I’ve already burned through 439.6M tokens on Cursor. 100% of weekly usage maxed out. Already dipping into extra credits. Still 3 days until the reset.
evidence.quotaPercent: Weekly included usage 100% used (screenshot). This is the weekly bar, not proven to share a window with the 439.6M total.

tokens.windowOnScreen: date filter Nov 1–13, 2026, not the weekly reset window

evidence.conflictsToKeep: 439.6M / 437.7M sit under a Nov 1–13 date filter (about 13 days). Weekly 100% resets Nov 16. These are not demonstrated to be the same window. Same class of misalignment as PatricioTrials 95% vs 7.7B and grokademy 2.1B/78%. Additional $2.10 this month is consistent with starting to use credits after included weekly was exhausted, but does not fix the window problem.
evidence.why: 官方控制台同时有周 100% 和 439.6M token，但 token 合计属于 Nov 1–13 日期筛选，不能当作单周池，禁止 439.6M÷100%。
